text_block_list.text: That was a decent start, I believe.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She looks troubled, but just as I'm about
to ask
her what's wrong...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey! What'd you think of the racer who
just
debuted in Kyoto the other day?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
I think the sky's the limit for her! What
about
you?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
It'd be an understatement to say I only
have "high
hopes" for her! I've gotta say,
this year's roster is
incredible. The
Classics are going to be fun to
watch!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
It seems there are many promising new
racers this
year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm unsure that I can contend with them
given my
current level of preparation.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
In order to achieve good results in the
Classic
Triple Crown, I must—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
Get a feel for your competition at the Keisei
Hai, right?

text_block_list.text:
Right. Depending on my results, we may
have to
adjust my training methods for
the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The most important thing for me is
completing
every race in the Classic
Triple Crown. That's
everything to me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
